Reception said my mum would here from a doctor, couple of hours pass and we didn’t hear back so we then called the surgery again to be told that my mum should call back the following morning to book an appointment for next Tuesday for a “review”  this would mean waiting 7 days for medical attention and we were not advised to call 111 or go to A & E.
We were not satisfied with the doctors response and I knew my mum needed urgent medical attention, so we called 111 where they sent an ambulance and the paramedics suggested mum should go to the hospital.

In one day of tests, the hospitals finding were that she had fluid on her lung (infection), jaundice and sodium levels extremely low which could have resulted to brain damage had it not been treated.
Had we have waited, god knows what could have happened to my mum, I write this review so people can know to not just sit and wait for an appointment because a week of waiting can be life changing.

We should have been advised by the GP to go to the hospital if they couldn’t assess my mum on that day but we were Surgery - Abbotswood Medical Centre, Katherine Place - Abbots Langley

This Surgery used to be an amazing Surgery, and a pleasure to visit, ironically, even when not feeling well.

Reception
When you ring up, the receptionists are very polite, but this is because your calls are being recorded, but when you go in, the awful toxic attitude starts.
To Be Fair, Not all of them.

I Dread ringing Reception, as there is always some attitude, as I mentioned, and as we are reminded, calls are recorded "For Training Purposes" and used against a stressed anxious patient.

Nothing has changed, nobody has been made accountable, and it's always the Patient's Fault, even when it's not
Many Old People, havn't got the strength or knowledge, to fight.

If the Receptionist, "Not All" are tired of their Job, or had a Bad day, or Personal Problems, we do care, but please don't take it out on us

Face to Face when they know they are not accountable, a couple of the Girls are rude, unhelpful, and often very impatient, and "Not Understanding" and very condescending and patronising.

To Be Fair, certain individuals are amazing, as mentioned before
If you hate the Job, get one where peoples lives arn't at risk

One of my Friends who has Mental Health issues, through no fault of HER own, had a dreadful experience, which was exacerbated by her treatment of the surgery

Doctors
The Doctors used to be amazing, but since Dr Khan and his Wife have left, it's a "Free for all"
The Doctors are more focussed on their Private Patients, so you hardly see the ones you want to see, and when you do, you have to be apologetic as they clearly don't have time, or wait weeks

Often a Temp or standby Doctor will be there, which is Ok.

It's totally about Money and focussing on their Private Patients
Being Polite is Free and a requirement

This is so Sad, and to be honest, I believe it's only time before there will be an incident of Negligence.

Trust has gone.

If you say anything, the attitude goes up, starting from Reception and onwards, and a real feeling of intimidation

Gone are the Days when the Doctors can be relied on, and to be honest, many feel that if they complain, they will get a poor service, due to stating what is their human need.

I'm Not happy about writing this review.

Your review has resurfaced - after nearly one whole year, but still no patient record or in fact any record of you actually visiting the practice, ever. 
We have thoroughly checked and have found no record of you as a patient, both last year when you posted this and recently, when you posted it again. 
If you are real we would love to chat. Particularly if this is still bothering you a year later. 
If not, can we suggest maybe submitting creative writing to a more appropriate platform, rather than misuse our Google page. We would really like to keep this open to real patient feedback. 

To all our patients and readers: we remain as always committed to delivering high-quality care and welcome honest, constructive feedback. 

Kind regards (again)
Abbotswood Medical Centre.

Dear Mary, 

Thank you for taking the time to leave a review. We are committed to providing an excellent service and take all feedback very seriously.


We are unable to find any record of your experience with us based on the details provided in your review. We pride ourselves on our high level of service which has recently been reflected in the GP patient survey results where 88% of respondents found the reception staff helpful compared with the national result of 83%. You will also see this mentioned in the local newspaper last week. Therefore, it is very disappointing to hear that you had a different experience. 

You state in your review that when you ring up the receptionists are always very polite. You then go on to say you dread ringing reception as there is always some attitude - please could you clarify which it is? You also state that no one has been made accountable, however, with no record of any issue being raised, it is not possible to ascertain accountability. Further clarification on whether the receptionists are or are not rude when calling, the lack of accountability for an issue that has not been made known and the toxic attitude you refer to would be extremely helpful. You can contact us directly on 01923 673060 so we can understand more about your situation and address your concerns in detail.

Whilst I would not normally reply to a public review in such detail, it is of great concern to the practice that you have made a serious accusation regarding private patients. Not only as this is false, but also that it is not possible for an individual to know how much private work is undertaken by any GP, without being employed by the practice. For clarity, all non NHS work must be carried out outside of NHS time and it is unclear where your misunderstanding regarding this has derived from. We therefore would need to investigate this further.

It is unfortunate that you raised your concerns with the practice in this way, if you are a genuine patient with genuine concerns. We are very responsive and will always work to resolve any issues a patient has faced using our service. However, making what can be viewed as defamatory accusations such as the level of private work the practice does and the concern for future negligence with no grounds for such remarks in addition to vague, contradictory concerns; leads us to have concerns regarding the authenticity of this review.

If you are a genuine patient at Abbotswood Medical Centre, I would kindly request that you raise this with us directly so we can discuss this prior to further investigation. We would like to address this personally and promptly. 

Thank you for giving us the opportunity to resolve this matter. 

Regards
